title: Oven Roasted Spanish Tobiko Paella Valenciana
description: A resinous and shattering Spanish dish featuring tobiko, with a smoky and ayurvedic-rajasic friendly flavor profile, in the form of a traditional Paella Valenciana.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the pan and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the calasparra rice to the pan and stir to combine with the chicken and spices.
Add the artichoke hearts, tobiko, and lemon juice to the pan and stir to combine.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the pan from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
